Hi, my name is Aaron. I’m best reached via twitter or email.
Nowadays, I mostly focus on ML systems (mainly distributed inference engine) and making sure they behave well at NVIDIA. My frequent interlocutors include my close friends.
As far as aesthetic goes, I enjoy cinema, actively avoiding cognitive offloading, strengthen fast-twitching muscles, solving puzzles, and making internet zines.
I just like writing code, and I hope to do this for as long as I can.
